event_name: Sahara Force India F1 Team Document 53 Date 24 June 2018 Time 20:05 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 47 & 48) and heard the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Car 10 collided with Car 31 in Turn 3.
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: A penalty of a Reprimand is imposed. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the current season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 10 (Pierre Gasly), the driver of car 31 (Esteban Ocon) and the team representatives. The driver of car 31 was optimistic in his move from the left of the track across to the apex of the corner. The driver of car 10 was also overly optimistic in his late braking into the corner. The Stewards are of the view that both drivers made errors which contributed to the collision. All Competitors are hereby reminded of their right to appeal certain
